summary.notes: Systemic: (1) WebFetch failed 10/10 with 'Unable to verify if domain is safe to fetch' - environment blocks claude.ai domain-safety verification, so the tool returned zero content for every URL. (2) Firecrawl passed 10/10 (HTTP 200, titles present, no JS-shell cases; react.dev and rust-lang.org returned server-rendered content); mostly cache hits; BBC result had an injected 'ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT' artifact line at top. (3) FreeGem: 8 pass, 1 short (example.com 156 chars), 1 hard fail (stackoverflow 403 bot-block); fastest ~1.4s avg; no JS rendering needed for the SSR pages tested; big pages truncated by --max-chars 20000. Latency for MCP tools (WebFetch/Firecrawl) is approximate from observed call duration; FreeGem measured wall-clock. Firecrawl content_chars marked exact where measured from persisted output, otherwise estimated from inline payload.
